description: This file defines the FrameDispatcher class, which manages communication and control of Frame objects within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for navigation, element interaction, evaluation, and event handling related to frames.

classes.name: FrameDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing Frame objects, enabling control and event handling within the Playwright framework.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing FrameDispatcher for a given frame within a scope.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Creates a FrameDispatcher if the frame is not null.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new FrameDispatcher instance, setting up event listeners and internal references.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates the frame to a specified URL.

methods.name: frameElement
methods.description: Retrieves the element handle for the frame.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression within the frame.

methods.name: evaluateExpressionHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression and returns a handle.

methods.name: waitForSelector
methods.description: Waits for a selector to appear in the frame.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event on a specified element.

methods.name: evalOnSelector
methods.description: Evaluates an expression on a specific element selected by a selector.

methods.name: evalOnSelectorAll
methods.description: Evaluates an expression on all elements matching a selector.

methods.name: querySelector
methods.description: Finds the first element matching a selector.

methods.name: querySelectorAll
methods.description: Finds all elements matching a selector.

methods.name: queryCount
methods.description: Counts the number of elements matching a selector.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Retrieves the HTML content of the frame.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the HTML content of the frame.

methods.name: addScriptTag
methods.description: Adds a script tag to the frame.

methods.name: addStyleTag
methods.description: Adds a style tag to the frame.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Simulates a click on an element.

methods.name: dblclick
methods.description: Simulates a double-click on an element.

methods.name: dragAndDrop
methods.description: Performs a drag and drop operation.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on an element.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills an input element with a value.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses an element.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Removes focus from an element.

methods.name: textContent
methods.description: Retrieves the text content of an element.

methods.name: innerText
methods.description: Retrieves the inner text of an element.

methods.name: innerHTML
methods.description: Retrieves the inner HTML of an element.

methods.name: resolveSelector
methods.description: Resolves a selector to an element.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Gets an attribute value from an element.

methods.name: inputValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an input element.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Checks if a checkbox or radio button is checked.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if an element is disabled.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Checks if an element is editable.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if an element is enabled.

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Checks if an element is hidden.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if an element is visible.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Hovers over an element.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects options in a select element.

methods.name: setInputFiles
methods.description: Sets files for an input element.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into an input element.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Presses a key on an element.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks a checkbox.

methods.name: uncheck
methods.description: Unchecks a checkbox.

methods.name: waitForTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a specified timeout.

methods.name: waitForFunction
methods.description: Waits for a function to evaluate to true.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Retrieves the page title.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights an element.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Performs an expectation/assertion on an element.

methods.name: ariaSnapshot
methods.description: Takes an ARIA snapshot of an element.
